dashboard.noPromises: No promises due today or missed.

remind.title: To remind today
remind.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the message and copy it.
remind.message: Namaste {{clientName}}, {{amount}} is outstanding on your credit account, {{days}} days overdue. Please pay at the earliest.

promise.title: Promise to pay
promise.pausesHint: Reminders pause until the promised date. If the amount is not paid by then, you are alerted the next day and reminders resume.
promise.invalidAmount: Enter an amount more than zero.
promise.invalidDate: Pick today or a later date.
promise.openUntil: Promised {{amount}} by {{date}}; reminders are paused until then.
promise.cancelHint: The promise is kept in the history as cancelled, with what was paid towards it so far. Reminders resume for this account.
promise.cancelReasonRequired: A reason is required to cancel a promise.
promise.limitsHint: At most {{days}} days ahead and at most what the account owes ({{outstanding}}).
promise.dateTooFar: Pick a date at most {{days}} days ahead.

hold.onHold: Credit on hold: {{days}} days overdue (held from {{holdDays}} days). New credit is refused until the client pays or the hold is overridden.
hold.willHold: Credit is held at {{holdDays}} days overdue.
hold.overrideExplanation: The client can take credit again until the date you pick. The override is recorded in the audit log and can be revoked like an extension.
hold.reasonRequired: Give a reason for the override.

followUp.subAccount: Follow-up is done on the parent account for the whole group.
followUp.subAccountNamed: Follow-up is done on the parent account ({{name}}) for the whole group.

statements.title: Monthly statements
statements.empty: No statements for this month. They are generated on the 1st for the month before.
statements.clientEmpty: No monthly statements yet. One is generated on the 1st of every month.

settings.title: Collections
settings.hint: When overdue clients are due a reminder, and when their new credit is held.
settings.stagesHelp: Separate with commas, e.g. 7, 15, 30. Leave empty to turn reminders off.
settings.stagesInvalid: Use different whole days from 1 to 365, at most 10.
settings.holdDaysHelp: Leave empty to never hold credit automatically.
settings.holdDaysInvalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 365, or leave empty.
settings.upiHint: Shown as a pay link and QR code on statements, reminders and the client balance page. PPMS does not confirm payments; record them as usual.
settings.upiIdInvalid: Enter a UPI ID like name@bank.
settings.payeeNameInvalid: Use letters, digits, spaces and . & ' - only.
settings.upiIncomplete: Enter both the UPI ID and the payee name, or neither.
settings.paymentsHint: When a manager's credit payment waits for an Owner or Admin to approve it.
settings.paymentThresholdHelp: A manager's payment above this waits for approval. Leave empty to let any amount through.
settings.paymentThresholdInvalid: Enter an amount above ₹0 with at most 2 decimals, or leave empty.
settings.backdatedDaysHelp: A manager's payment dated more days back than this waits for approval, whatever its amount.
settings.backdatedDaysInvalid: Use a whole number from 0 to 365.
